workstreams.name: Conversion cost baseline
workstreams.answers: What is conversion cost per part at the Braga plant today, and where does it build up?
activities: Calculate conversion cost per part from operational data
Observe lines on the floor and record where losses occur
Interview the people who run the lines about cost drivers

workstreams.name: Cost improvement sizing
workstreams.answers: Which improvements can lower conversion cost per part by a measurable amount, and what is each worth?
activities: Identify candidate improvements from the losses found
Size each improvement's effect on cost per part from data
Prepare the sized improvement list for the go/no-go decision

workstreams.name: Improvement implementation
workstreams.answers: How are the chosen improvements put in place at the Braga plant, and in what order?
activities: Detail each chosen improvement and set the order of changes
Prepare the changes with the people who run the lines
Put the changes into operation after the steering workshop

workstreams.name: Cost per part tracking
workstreams.answers: Do the improvements keep running, and does cost per part fall against the baseline?
activities: Set up a tracker of cost per part against the baseline
Check that each improvement keeps running on the floor
Compare operational data on cost per part with the baseline

workstreams.name: Plant team capability
workstreams.answers: Can the Braga plant team run the improvements and keep them going after handover?
activities: Train the plant team on the changed ways of working
Coach the plant team as they run the changes themselves
Document who owns each improvement for the handover
